Pitch A — Premier 7s

Dhanmondi branch · 60 × 40 m · FIFA Quality Pro artificial grass · LED floodlights

4.9 · 312 reviews Floodlit Split pitch
Video tour · captions

About this pitch

Our flagship 7-a-side pitch, rebuilt in 2025 with a 50 mm FIFA Quality Pro carpet over a 20 mm shock pad for lower impact on knees and ankles. Book the full pitch, or one of two independent 5-a-side halves separated by a retractable net.

Branch
Dhanmondi (Main) — House 12, Road 27, Dhanmondi, Dhaka 1209
Size
60 × 40 m (halves 40 × 30 m)
Surface
FIFA Quality Pro artificial grass, 50 mm, rubber infill
Capacity
14 players (full) · 10 per half
Sports
Football 7s & 5s, box cricket
Booking options
Full pitch, Half 1 (North), Half 2 (South)
Opening hours
06:00 – 24:00 daily (last slot 22:30 for 90 min)
Floodlights
LED, 500 lux, from 6 PM (৳300/h)

How split booking works

Full pitch

Blocks both halves for the same time.

Check slots Half 1 — North

Blocks the full pitch; Half 2 stays bookable.

Check slots Half 2 — South

Blocks the full pitch; Half 1 stays bookable.

Ground rules & safety

  • Moulded or turf boots only — no metal studs
  • No chewing gum, glass or smoking on the pitch
  • Arrive 10 minutes early; 10-minute grace period
  • Under-14s must be accompanied by an adult
  • First-aid kit and trained staff on duty
  • AED defibrillator at reception
  • CCTV covers all pitches and parking
  • Emergency exits marked; evacuation point: car park
